arXiv:math/9809057 (math)
[Submitted on 10 Sep 1998]

Title: On the Lego-Teichmuller game

Authors: Bojko Bakalov , Alexander Kirillov
View PDF HTML (experimental)
Abstract: For a smooth oriented surface S, denote by M(S) the set of all ways to represent S as a result of gluing together standard spheres with holes (``the Lego game''). In this paper we give a full set of simple moves and relations which turn M(S) into a connected and simply-connected 2-complex. Results of this kind were first obtained by Moore and Seiberg, but their paper contains serious gaps. Our proof is based on a different approach and is much more rigorous.
